sourceChecks: Service-issued full scene belongs to project, session, document and view generation.
Presented confirmation and Done hold follow view operation order; altered sequence replay is rejected.
The current confirmed base scene survives candidate expiry and candidate retention limits.
Done hold accepts the confirmed presentation and verifies retained HTML frame ownership.
Confirmed HTML frames are retained until presentation replacement or view close.
First annotation save and source binding share the draft transaction and version.
Read, save, prepare and Send resolve the same durable annotation source.
Moving or deleting an object after Done preserves the service-delivered object version.
New target or source advances the annotation version; text changes preserve the source.
Queued request edits inherit their original source; new targets use a new Done source.
Closed views reject fresh holds; persisted evidence can complete after close and restart.
Explicit object references retain their independent Send availability rule.
PNG bytes, decoded dimensions, crop mapping and original capture guards remain enforced.
Normalized object geometry uses contentWorldBounds, including letterboxing.
The presentation camera stores actual positive CSS-adjusted scale; source capture uses that same scale.
HTML surface owner includes the service-delivered asset identity.
Media precision and frame index are validated and retained in scene and capture conversion.

providerChecks: Freeze callback runs synchronously before presentation, hold or draft requests.
Pixels and copied presentation metadata survive later scene changes.
Lost hold, save, prepare and upload responses recover the same source and capture identities.
Bounded encoding retry reuses copied pixels.
Cancelled upload advances the service version and rejects delayed completion.
A new document resumes supplied persisted PNG pixels using the durable source after original view close and service restart.
Pending capture limits include pixel copies awaiting queued service saves.
Pending freeze identity is registered synchronously and remains cancellable before a capture version exists.
Cancellation during a delayed Done hold saves no annotation and accepts no late source.
Cancellation during a committed save response queries the matching source and invalidates its version while retaining the latest request body and annotation comment.
Close cancels pending stages and rejects late persistence completion.
